title: Proper direct image preserves the normalized quotient completion unit
statement:
Fix the adic coefficient datum $A,I$ of [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum]. For every scheme $T$ let $D(T)$ be the unbounded derived category of modules over the constant coefficient sheaf $\underline A_T$, let $\mathcal R_T$ be its strict quotient reduction tower, $L_T=R\lim_T$, and $\eta_T:1\to L_T\mathcal R_T$ the specified quotient completion unit of [lem-sp-completion-mate-comparison]. For any scheme morphism $p:U\to Y$ use the derived constant-coefficient direct image $p_*$, strict tower direct image $R_p$, and prescribed comparison $a_p:p_*L_U\xrightarrow{\sim}L_YR_p$ of that node. For $K\in D(U)$ let $\pi_{p,K}:\mathcal R_Y(p_*K)\to R_p(\mathcal R_UK)$ be the adjunct of reduction of the ambient counit under its normalized reduction/pullback isomorphism. Then
$$a_p(\mathcal R_UK)\circ p_*(\eta_U(K))=L_Y(\pi_{p,K})\circ\eta_Y(p_*K).$$
This is equality of the prescribed morphisms in $D(Y)$ with every strict quotient transition retained. Neither completeness of $K$ nor faithfulness of evaluation is assumed.

lean.statement:
theorem supportProperUnitNormalization {A : Type (t + 1)} [CommRing A]
    (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A) {U Y : Scheme.{t}} (p : U ⟶ Y)
    (K : D (A := A) U) :
    (push (A := A) p).map ((unit d U).app K) ≫
        (directLimitIso (A := A) p).hom.app ((reduction d U).obj K) =
      (unit d Y).app ((push (A := A) p).obj K) ≫
        (rlim (A := A) Y).map (projection d p K)
